context.content: Hey everyone, I posted a similar post yesterday but I need new solutions so... I arrived in Eindhoven today from an orange country and I’m staying at the Student Hotel as a student for the rest of the year. I’ll be in self-quarantine for 14 days and I’m strictly not allowed to go out of my room and I can’t contact the delivery person since I’m in quarantine to pay during delivery I was planning to shop online for groceries but turns out, neither Albert Heijne nor Jumbo allows online payments. Waiting List on Pic-Nic is too long. Are there any grocery shops you know of that allows for online payments? I feel really trapped in quarantine with my only option being 8€ meal of the hotel, so any help is much appreciated. Cheers!
